message.content:
**Classic Lasagna Ingredients** | Category | Typical Items | |----------|---------------| | **Pasta** | • 9–12 sheets (no‑boil or regular) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef
• ½ lb Italian sausage (optional)
• 2 cups crushed tomatoes or passata
• 1 cup tomato sauce
• ¼ cup red wine (optional)
• 1 onion, finely chopped
• 2 cloves garlic, minced
• Salt & pepper to taste
• Fresh basil or oregano | | **Bechamel / White Sauce** | • 4 Tbsp butter
• ⅓ cup all‑purpose flour
• 4 cups milk (whole or 2%*)
• Pinch nutmeg
• Salt & white pepper | | **Cheeses** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese
• ¾ cup grated Parmesan
• 8 oz shredded mozzarella (or provolone/Fontina mix) | | **Extras** | • Optional spinach or sautéed mushrooms
• Extra herbs (parsley, thyme) | *Tip:* For richer flavor you can add a splash of heavy cream to the béchamel or swirl some pesto into the meat sauce. Adjust quantities based on how many servings you want—this recipe makes roughly 6–8 people.*
